thread:
Ethan M.: Partner BrightGate just hit a PO hold in EU marketplace. Error: missing VAT reg number for B2B invoice. They need an invoice before month-end renewal. Can someone triage? :pray:
Rina C. (Finance): Do we have the partner's billing country and VAT number they submitted? I can check if it's a format issue vs missing field.
Ethan M.: Partner provided VAT: GB999 8880 12 (with space). Portal rejects it. Link to PO: https://marketplace.eu.redwood/orders/5551
marketplace-bot: System: validation error MKT-VAT-FORMAT. EU VAT must match regex ^[A-Z]{2}[0-9A-Z]{8,12}$
Omar L. (Legal): If it's just formatting, Ops can normalize. If partner intentionally included spaces, we should accept canonicalized VAT but need a signed attestation for B2B tax treatment in some countries. Which country?
Tess Y. (Sales): BrightGate is UK-based. AM says they can resend VAT without spaces, or provide company VAT certificate scan now. They want to close before EOD.
Rina C. (Finance): Quick fix: accept canonicalized VAT in ledger (strip spaces) and re-run validation. I'll approve a one-time normalization if legal OKs. Audit note required.
Omar L. (Legal): Fine to normalize and accept for PO acceptance only. Please attach VAT certificate to the order record. I'll sign off on the attestation text: "Redwood accepts normalized VAT GB999888012 for taxation purposes for PO #5551; partner VAT certificate attached."
marketplace-bot: System: ticket created #MP-9990 for manual VAT normalization and attestation upload.
Ethan M.: Plan: (1) AM asks partner to upload VAT certificate to ticket, (2) Rina applies normalization in ledger, (3) Omar posts attestation to ticket, (4) Ops retries PO ingest.
Tess Y. (Sales): Partner uploaded PDF of VAT cert and company registration. Forwarded to ticket.
Rina C. (Finance): Normalization applied (ledger ref LED-R-77). Added audit note.
marketplace-bot: System: MP-9990 updated  attachments present. Validation re-run queued.
Ethan M.: Ops retried API call:
POST /api/v1/orders/ingest
Header: x-region: eu-west-1
Body: { "po": "5551", "vat": "GB999888012" }
marketplace-bot: System: Order 5551 accepted. Status: ACCEPTED.
Tess Y. (Sales): :tada: BrightGate confirmed invoice issued and renewal preserved. Thanks team!
Omar L. (Legal): I'll add the normalization note and attestation template to the Partnerships playbook so AMs know to send VAT certs without extra chars.
Rina C. (Finance): I'll follow up with Product to consider normalizing whitespace automatically on EU VAT input to reduce friction.
Ethan M.: Closing ticket and thread. :white_check_mark:
